Process observation (not a curriculum defect, reported for the maintainer/tooling, not carded): story.md's trace-caching protocol keys `content_sha`/`phase_sha` on 'sha256 of full file' — read literally, that is this exercise file's OWN raw sha, which does not move when only an INCLUDED {{prompt:}} registry file changes. This exercise's raw sha happened to move anyway (an unrelated maintainer Quality-line edit), which accidentally forced a cache-miss and a fresh look; had that coincidence not occurred, a stale trace could have shipped as 'cached' and true even though the actual rendered prompt content had changed. The dispatch preamble's cache-integrity clause (grep any carried quote against the live file before trusting it) is what actually caught this, not the sha match — worth the maintainer's attention as a possible gap in how trace freshness is keyed for exercises whose fences are {{prompt:}} includes rather than inline text.
